hero.title: AI SATHI
hero.subtitle: Your Intelligent Assistant for Indian Standards & BIS Services
hero.description: Ask anything about Indian Standards, BIS certification, QCOs, testing laboratories, hallmarking, compliance requirements, and related BIS services.
hero.capabilitiesTitle: What AI SATHI can help you with
hero.trustText: AI SATHI uses document-based retrieval and verified sources to provide grounded responses. Wherever supporting evidence is available, responses include source references and citations.
hero.insufficientText: If sufficient evidence is not available, AI SATHI clearly indicates that instead of generating unsupported information.
hero.disclaimer: AI SATHI provides informational guidance based on available BIS sources. It does not replace an official BIS determination, certification decision, or regulatory authority.
